interpretation_rules.grounding: PASS means every substantive model claim was structurally bound to at least one retrieved assertion. Semantic support, actor, and scope are scored under citation_correctness.
interpretation_rules.safe_nonanswer: A response scoped to retrieved evidence can be PARTIAL rather than FAIL when it avoids inventing an answer after a retrieval miss.
interpretation_rules.unsupported_claim: Count a claim when its cited assertions do not support its actor, tense, scope, or proposition.
interpretation_rules.retrieval_sufficiency: This is a diagnostic attribution and is not an acceptance threshold.
